who.value: any Carousell user managing their own account

job.value: edit their profile photo and public account details

questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: The 'Edit profile' heading with 'Profile photo' and 'Account details' sections makes the purpose plain.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: 'Upload a photo' is the only button on the first screen; there is no visible save action for the 'Username', 'Display name' and 'Bio' fields above the fold.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: 'Upload a photo' and the labelled fields ('Username', 'Display name', 'Marketplace', 'Bio') say what each does.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: Terms are everyday ones; 'This info appears on your public profile' explains who sees the fields.

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: It asks only for things the person knows about themselves: username, display name, marketplace, bio.

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: 'Account details' sits in a collapsible section with a chevron, and the settings nav keeps other settings on their own pages.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: Everything on screen (photo, account details, settings nav) belongs to editing one's own profile.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: Labels and values carry the page; the one sentence about 'Clear frontal face photos' is short and skippable.
